title: Revocability, Suspension and Duration of Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders
content:
Who may stop a holding under Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders, how quickly deductions stop, whether the holding can be suspended, and whether it survives the end of the claim all differ by kind.

## Terms by kind

| Kind | Claimant may stop it | Business days after a confirmed revocation before deductions stop | Starts and stops allowed per benefit year of the claim | May be suspended on the issuing agency's notice | Business days after the issuing agency's termination notice before deductions stop | Follows the claimant to payments on a later claim | Ends when the claim it was made on closes or is withdrawn | Ending the current support obligation leaves an arrears-only order to be received separately |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Voluntary Federal Income Tax Withholding | Yes | 2 | 2 | No | 0 | No | Yes | No |
| Voluntary State Income Tax Withholding | Yes | 2 | 2 | No | 0 | No | Yes | No |
| Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order | No | 0 — not revocable | 0 — not an election | Yes | 5 | Yes | No | Yes |
| Child Support Withholding — Arrears-Only Order | No | 0 — not revocable | 0 — not an election | Yes | 5 | Yes | No | No |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Household or Agency Error | No | 0 — not revocable | 0 — not an election | Yes | 5 | Yes | No | No |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Intentional Program Violation | No | 0 — not revocable | 0 — not an election | Yes | 5 | Yes | No | No |

In the termination column, 0 means deductions stop immediately on the next payment.

## Questions answered from the table

**Which kinds can the claimant stop?**
Only Voluntary Federal Income Tax Withholding and Voluntary State Income Tax Withholding. For each, deductions stop 2 business days after the revocation is confirmed. The four agency kinds show 0 in the revocation column, which means they are not revocable by the claimant.

**How many times may a claimant start or stop a voluntary election?**
For each voluntary kind, 2 starts and stops in total per benefit year of the claim. The agency kinds show 0, which means they are not elections at all.

**Which kinds may be suspended?**
The two child support kinds and the two SNAP Overissuance Recovery kinds, on the issuing agency's notice. Neither voluntary kind may be suspended.

**When an issuing agency sends a termination notice, when do deductions stop?**
For the four agency kinds, 5 business days after the agency's termination notice. The voluntary kinds show 0, meaning immediately on the next payment.

**What happens to a holding when the claim it was made on closes?**
A voluntary election (federal or state) ends when its claim closes or is withdrawn, and does not follow the claimant to a later claim. The four agency kinds do not end on claim closure and follow the claimant to payments on a later claim.

**What is special about a current support order?**
It is the only kind marked "yes" in the last column: ending the current support obligation leaves an arrears-only order to be received separately.
